subject.title: feat: node-hosted plugins — dynamic tools, MCP servers, and skills

question: Should an existing paired node automatically gain ongoing authority to publish and replace agent-visible tools and skill instructions after upgrade, or must the gateway operator explicitly opt in?
rationale: The code can safely implement either policy, but the meaning of node pairing and the acceptable upgrade default are product/security intent that repository evidence cannot decide.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Default the new gateway publication controls off and require operators to enable trusted node-host tools and skills deliberately.

options.title: Accept paired-node authority
options.body: Keep the controls default-on and explicitly document pairing as delegation of ongoing tool and skill publication authority.

options.title: Split the first release
options.body: Land the narrower command-backed tool substrate and defer native MCP/skill publication until the broader trust contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Default the new gateway publication controls off and require operators to enable trusted node-host tools and skills deliberately.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this person most directly to the node-host command seam and public plugin API surface at the center of the decision.
